title: Two-Step Button
summary: Needs two deliberate clicks for a destructive action: the first arms it with a draining timer, the second confirms.
description: Destructive button where the first click arms it with a draining timer and a second deliberate click confirms; accidental double-clicks, held keys, blur, Escape or the timeout all disarm it.
catches: Losing focus, Escape or timeout, which disarm
limits: A deliberate second click still confirms; it is not a full review step
a11y: Arming is announced via a polite live region (armedHint)
Escape disarms; held Enter is ignored
aria-busy while an async confirm is pending
Label changes are text, not colour alone
